name: cursor-ai-agent-tooling-projects
description: Local-first TypeScript tooling for AI coding agents: MCP governance, multi-agent control, and verification-as-a-tool.
author: dqmjr

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix mcp-sentinel && npm install --prefix agent-control-room && npm install --prefix verify-mcp
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix mcp-sentinel && npm run build --prefix agent-control-room && npm run build --prefix verify-mcp
scripts.test: npm test --prefix mcp-sentinel && npm test --prefix agent-control-room && npm test --prefix verify-mcp
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix mcp-sentinel && npm run lint --prefix agent-control-room && npm run lint --prefix verify-mcp
scripts.demo:sentinel: npm run smoke --prefix mcp-sentinel && npm --prefix mcp-sentinel exec -- tsx src/cli.ts dashboard -c examples/smoke-config.json
